title: The Fourteenth Answer
description: The chain drum answers the lake with fourteen measured blows. Odran's bound hand tightens on the emergency pawl whenever the ninth blow passes, as though five replies have been withheld.

terminal_outcomes.result: The pressure release has already failed. Gate Seven is jammed under a full head, and the Walking Ward bells are answering the surge.

defeat_outcome.result: The last chain beat breaks out of cadence. Odran's body holds Gate Seven in its emergency notch, but the pressure below remains unresolved.
defeat_outcome.chronicle: Odran Third-Bell was slain at Gate Seven. The lower chain stopped between its ninth and tenth answers.

choices.label: Answer all fourteen names
choices.description: Match the Third Bell cadence and restore the five closure workers cut from the public roll.
choices.result: At the fourteenth name, Odran releases the pawl. The black webbing stays in the chain, but the man inside it remembers how to stop pulling.
choices.chronicle: Fourteen names were answered at Gate Seven. Odran Third-Bell released the emergency pawl without opening the lower gate.

choices.label: Brace the counterpressure
choices.description: Use the charcoal Walking Ward scale to arrest the Crown's late closure order at its safest surviving mark.
choices.result: The counterweight settles one notch below the royal mark. Odran remains bound, breathing in time with a gate that can no longer complete its turn.
choices.chronicle: Gate Seven was rebraced to the Walking Ward's counterpressure scale. Odran remains bound, and the deepest passage stays sealed.
